reason: The cited evidence directly supports all key premises: E1 and E2 explicitly state that SRO fluctuations cause shear-fault energy fluctuations, create HAMs that pin dislocations into wavy paths, and govern strength; E3 shows LCO (SRO) changes with processing, increases energy landscape ruggedness and activation barriers, and that severe deformation reduces LCO. The representation is accurate and no premise is unsupported or contradicted.
premises: Spatial fluctuations in local chemical SRO exist in equiatomic NiCoCr and lead to fluctuations in shear-fault energy
These fluctuations create hard atomic motifs (HAMs) that pin dislocations
Pinning by HAMs forces dislocations into wavy, jumpy paths
This wavy dislocation motion increases yield strength by raising the activation barrier for glide
The effect can be tuned by thermal/mechanical processing to vary SRO while keeping grain size constant
